newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to bounce then slip towards 114-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to bounce then slip towards 114-00.

text.p: September gilt futures will head lower after an initial bounce and could reach 114-00 on Monday, technical analysts said.

Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said early in the session the contract could test 115-02 or even 115-10 on the upside but was unlikely to breach that region and would then seek a re-test of 114-16.
"If we can get down through 114-16 and sustain the break then we are looking for losses down to 114-00," she said.
A 38.2 percent Fibonacci retracement of the rally from 112-02 on May 22 to the contract high of 116-02 comes in at 114-16.
The 114-00 level is a 50 percent retracement of the same rally and a major trendline, Miller said.
At 0717 GMT, September gilts were at 114-23 down 6/32.
Miller said there had been a bearish crossover on daily Stochastics and sell signals were evident on candlestick charts.
"It looks likely we are going to see 114-00 again and if we break that we could have another half-point drop very quickly," she said.
Juliette Clark, senior treasury manager at the Royal Bank of Scotland in London said there was growing evidence in favour of a long term trend reversal.
But she recommended longer term players maintain a neutral tone for now.
"A move higher to form a second lower top, followed by another sharp sell-off is needed to complete the bear signal," Clark said in a note to clients.
Provided initial activity did not breach 114-13, 114-15 support, there could be a slight short term swing higher towards resistance at 114-31 and above there 115-07, 08.
"A break below support at 114-13, 15 is unlikely but should not be ruled out," Clark said. "The near term target is then 113-11, with support on the way at 114-06 and then 113-24."
At the short end, December short sterling was at 92.47, down four basis points on the day.
